nodes.label: Label-Left Control-Right Row
nodes.rationale: Each setting is a two-column row: a left-aligned name and a right-aligned control of uniform width so mixed widget types (checkbox, slider, text, combo, color, keybind) share one visual grid.

nodes.label: Integer Versus Number Slider Split
nodes.rationale: Integer and Number share the same slider chrome but differ in readout: Integer shows a whole value (2) while Number shows a decimal (0.1), so discrete and continuous numeric settings are distinct widget types.

nodes.label: RGBA Hex Extends RGB Color
nodes.rationale: Color without alpha uses a 6-digit RGB hex (00FFFF) beside a saturated swatch; Color with alpha uses an 8-digit RGBA hex (00000055) beside a semi-transparent swatch, so alpha is an extra nibble pair on the same color-row pattern.

nodes.label: Plugin Config Widget Catalog
nodes.rationale: The dialog is a demo catalog of supported plugin config widgets, not a live product page: dummy labels (Toggle, Integer, Number, Text, Dropdown, Color, Color with alpha, Keybind, Button) and placeholder values (Default Text, First Alpha, none) enumerate every control type the config UI can host.

nodes.label: Planet CloudLayers Weather Map
nodes.rationale: Nearest planet that has CloudLayers supplies shell altitude, tint, wind, and the weather map.

nodes.label: HDR Lift
nodes.rationale: Optional HDR lift when an HdrRender-class Display tenant is live. Default 4; 1 = SDR.

nodes.label: AfterAtmosphere IsolatedMix volumetric.clouds
nodes.rationale: Clouds occlude sky and sun. Anomaly Show Status should list Fullscreen: AfterAtmosphere/IsolatedMix:volumetric.clouds.

nodes.label: Pulsar Local Deploy
nodes.rationale: Each successful build copies plugin.dll, plugin.xml, and Pack/ into Pulsar Local: net48 to Legacy/Local/Clouds/, net10.0 to Interim/Local/Clouds/. Version lives in Version.Build.props; folder overrides via setup.py into Directory.Build.props.user.

nodes.label: Pulsar Plugin Settings Dialog
nodes.rationale: The Pulsar plugin Settings dialog still works without Rich HUD Master.

nodes.label: Raymarch Quality Presets
nodes.rationale: Low 16 / Medium 24 / High 32 / Ultra 48 view steps (light march 2 / 3 / 4 / 4).

nodes.label: Anomaly SafetyScale
nodes.rationale: Camera motion drops view steps via Anomaly SafetyScale.

nodes.label: Volumetric Clouds Pack
nodes.rationale: Replaces Keen textured planet CloudSphere layers with spherical, raymarched volumetric clouds. Enabling the pack auto-enables Anomaly.

nodes.label: Anomaly Owns Shared Rendering Gaps
nodes.rationale: When this pack invents lighting, IsolatedMix energy, or march LOD that the next Anomaly shader will also need, file it on Anomaly Docs/Extensibility.md Slice AI and wiki/Framework-gaps.md rather than leaving it pack-private.

nodes.label: Rich HUD Deferred Config Save
nodes.rationale: Rich HUD sliders must not serialize or write config on every tick; ControlChanged can fire on every mouse move and a per-tick XmlSerializer/File.CreateText stalls work that later shows up as a GPU reset.

nodes.label: Clouds.cfg Deferred Save
nodes.rationale: Settings write {UserDataPath}/Storage/Clouds.cfg after the sliders are quiet (~400 ms). They do not write on every mouse move.

nodes.label: Replace Vanilla Layers
nodes.rationale: Harmony skip of Keen MyCloudRenderer.Render while the pack is registered, enabled, and Replace vanilla layers is on. Turn that off (or disable the pack) to bring Keen spheres back.

nodes.label: SE-DLSS Cloud Ghosting
nodes.rationale: With SE-DLSS, some sky-through-cloud ghosting is expected in v1 (color in, no cloud motion vectors).
